info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Risk Assessment API
info.description: The Credit Risk Assessment API provides essential functionality for evaluating credit risk within wholesale trading operations. Users can retrieve detailed risk profiles and assessments based on specific criteria, facilitating informed decision-making in lending and investment contexts. Typically utilized by risk analysts and financial institutions, this API streamlines the process of monitoring credit exposures and compliance requirements. By accessing comprehensive risk data, organizations can enhance their credit management strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed information of a specific credit risk operation identified by its unique resource ID. The response includes comprehensive details regarding the operation's attributes and status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving credit risk operation details. Please ensure the structure of the request body adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the response contains the requested data.

GetCreditRiskOperationByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the credit risk operations API. It can be used to provide a string input as part of the request.

tradingBookId.description: The unique identifier for the trading book.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument.

side.description: The side of the transaction, either 'buy' or 'sell'.

quantity.description: The quantity of the instrument being traded.

limitPrice.description: The limit price object detailing the price of the instrument in the specified currency.

recordStatus.description: Status of the record, indicating if it is active, inactive, etc.

version.description: The version number of the operation record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the operation was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the operation, including identifiers and timestamps.

GetCreditRiskOperationByIdResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving operations in the wholesale trading credit risk operations.

value.description: The price value of the instrument.

currency.description: The currency in which the price is denominated.

LimitPrice.description: Schema for the limit price of a financial instrument.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for tracking the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The geographic region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Metadata information associated with the operation.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint that is being called. This value helps in tracking the specific API endpoint used in the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that is executing the API call. This header provides context about which application is making the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer token for authentication, typically formatted as a JSON Web Token (JWT). The token should be included in the Authorization header as 'Bearer {token}' to access secured endpoints.
